# sonarqube_groups (Data Source)

Lists groups, sorted by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_groups" "teams" {
  search = "team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Case-insensitive partial match on the group name. Omit to list every group.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Matching groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default group that every new user joins.
- `description` (String) Group description.
- `id` (String) Group UUID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the group is provisioned by an external identity provider (GitHub, GitLab or SCIM) and cannot be changed in SonarQube.
- `name` (String) Group name.
